messages:
mia: heading to the SF office next Tues (Mid-Market). Any recs for a casual spot that has at least 2 good vegan mains and is nut-safe? We'll be ~8 ppl and want easy group seating.
sam: Market Harvest on 9th is solid - big grain bowls, specify no nuts and they'll switch the dressing. casual, big tables. +1 minute walk from the office.
diego: +1 Market Harvest. also check the tofu banh mi at Pho Union (a block away) if you want something cheaper and fast. they keep peanuts on the side.
harper: Bento Box on 5th has dedicated GF & nut-free prep area fyi. food's not fancy but everyone finds something.
nora: if you want sit-down w/ ordering for a group, The Grove / Coop Kitchen has a giant vegan sampler platter we did last offsite. They do preorders for groups of 6+.
mia: @nora do they take preorders via email or is phone better?
nora: email is best, they'll send a PDF menu. i can forward last week's preorder if helpful.
Sam: quick poll - prefer: 1) Market Harvest (bowls, fast), 2) Coop Kitchen (sit-down, preorder), 3) Bento Box (GF & nut-aware). react with :one: :two: or :three:.
lunchbot: Poll created - vote with reactions.
diego: voted :one: - easy for a team lunch and keeps everyone moving after.
harper: :two: from me - brought my parents and they loved the sampler.
mia: Thanks all - leaning Market Harvest for speed. Nora, can you forward that Coop Kitchen preorder menu just in case?
nora: sending now.
mia: Cool. I'll ping when I book and drop a link to the menu. Also FYI: one person in our group has a tree-nut allergy, so I'll call ahead to confirm nut-handling.
sam: great call. if you want I can swing by tomorrow at noon and confirm with Market Harvest (ask about cross-contact).
mia: that'd be awesome, thanks Sam :thumbsup: 
lunchbot: Reminder set: "confirm group menu" for 1958010800.
